package com.acme.billing;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import static java.lang.Math.max;
import com.acme.ledger.*;

/** Accrues interest on an account. */
public class Engine {
    private static final int DEFAULT_RATE = 3;
    private final int rate;
    private List<String> names;

    public Engine(int rate) {
        this.rate = rate;
    }

    // Interest for one period.
    public int accrue(int amount) {
        int local = amount * rate;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            local += i;
        }
        return max(local, DEFAULT_RATE);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Engine engine = new Engine(5);
        System.out.println(engine.accrue(100));
    }
}
